entities.summary: Celtic Norican, a notable figure in the history of Austria, associated with Hallstatt Celtic Culture & Roman Noricum (15 BCE–476). Preceded by Roman Province of Noricum and Roman Empire. Their legacy influenced Peak of trans-Alpine salt trade networks c. 600 BCE and First written mention of 'Ostarrîchi' in 996 CE.
